expectedRealization.rationale: Post-531 demand and polysilicon-price reset can affect upstream earnings within quarters; no positive company engine is strong enough at cutoff to override the adverse physical state.

changeHypothesis.summary: The 531 policy shock had already pushed solar-grade polysilicon prices down about 30% from end-May to mid-July, with only a small rebound by end-August. Long-run grid-parity optimism did not erase the current upstream margin reset.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Demand-policy resets and upstream overcapacity can pressure pricing for quarters until supply/demand rebalances.
disconfirmingEvidence: Longi H1 revenue grew strongly but ex-item profit was nearly flat.
Tongwei H1 profit grew only moderately and operating cash flow weakened.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Polysilicon demand and spot prices reset sharply after 531.
Longi revenue growth did not translate into strong ex-item profit growth.
Tongwei had only moderate profit growth and weaker operating cash flow.
PV equity price regime was neutral and mixed across horizons.

causalChain.mechanism: Weaker domestic demand reduces upstream utilization and pricing power.
causalChain.failureMode: export demand or supply shutdowns rebalance faster than expected

causalChain.mechanism: Upstream producers face margin pressure while low-cost downstream leaders may benefit only if cost reductions outpace ASP declines.
causalChain.failureMode: cost/share advantages dominate the physical reset

directWinners: potential low-cost survivors only if share/cost gains exceed ASP decline
secondOrderWinners: developers benefiting from lower module costs
falseThemeMatches: PV names supported only by long-run grid-parity narrative while current earnings deteriorate

earningsSensitivity.favorable: Cost/share gains outrun industry ASP decline.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Price reset compresses margins faster than costs fall.

selectionComparison.rationale: No positive listed expression has a strong enough frozen cost/share/earnings bridge to overcome the current physical reset.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: PV basket had +2.37pp 20d but -7.13pp 60d excess, with only one-third positive 60d breadth.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Do not let long-run grid-parity optimism erase the current demand/price reset; require a verified company cost/share engine first.
expectations.measurableGap: No sufficiently measured positive company-specific gap is frozen.

hypothesisDecompositionTest.productMarketScope: post-531 polysilicon/wafer/module economics separated by cost position
hypothesisDecompositionTest.geographicScope: China PV market with export offset possible
hypothesisDecompositionTest.rationale: The memo preserves near-term upstream price pressure separately from long-run grid parity and potential low-cost survivor benefits.

nearTerm.driver: post-531 demand shock and polysilicon price collapse

mediumTerm.driver: supply rationalization and company cost/share differences may emerge

structural.driver: grid parity can expand long-run demand after industry reset

evidenceHorizonMatrix.resolutionRule: Do not use structural grid-parity optimism to override the current negative physical earnings path without a company-specific bridge.

leaderDivergenceTest.rationale: Company cost/share advantages are not yet strong enough in frozen H1 earnings to establish a clean positive divergence.

upstreamState.variable: effective PV demand relative to upstream productive capacity
upstreamState.economicRole: determines future upstream utilization, clearing price and producer margin

downstreamFlow.variable: polysilicon spot price and current producer earnings
downstreamFlow.temporaryDistortion: No opposite temporary distortion is established; the downstream price move already confirms the adverse upstream demand/capacity state.

causalLagBridge.rationale: Post-531 weaker demand had already translated into a roughly 30% polysilicon price reset.

crossSectionalCorroboration.rationale: PV equities and company earnings are mixed rather than showing a broad positive survivor engine.

causalStateVariableTest.falsifier: Demand/capacity balance improves enough that prices and low-cost leader earnings show a verified positive turn.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: No selection: upstream demand/capacity and downstream prices are aligned negatively; no verified positive company engine overrides the reset.

bearCase: For a long thesis, structural grid-parity optimism arrives before the current physical reset and company margins have stabilized.

invalidationConditions.indicator: polysilicon/wafer pricing and low-cost leader margins
invalidationConditions.threshold: clear positive stabilization with company earnings conversion

caveats: No later PV recovery is imported into the cutoff.
